# What the Archicad API *can't do.*

Tapir uses the Archicad API that Graphisoft publishes for add-ons, and covers all of it that can be a JSON command. What that API does not offer, Tapir cannot offer either. This page lists what people ask for that is not in it, with what to do instead.

## The *list.*

It is also what Tapir would like the Archicad API to offer, and the list Tapir sends to Graphisoft. Every row was checked in the headers of the Archicad API DevKits of Archicad 25 to 30, the versions Tapir is built for; the Evidence column names the headers and functions.

| What people want | Status | What to do instead | Evidence | Issue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Elements | | | | |
| Explode an element into its parts, as Edit > Reshape > Explode into Current View does | Not possible | Nothing yet | No explode function in `ACAPinc.h`, the `ACAPI_*.h` headers or the `ACAPI::` modules (AC25–AC30). `APIAttrCreationMethod_Explode` (`APIdefs_Attributes.h`) only tells how an attribute was created. | – |
| Anchor the sill or header of a window or door to the project zero or to a reference level | Workaround | Anchor it to a story with `verticalLink` `SillToStory` or `HeaderToStory` in [ModifyWindows](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyWindows) or [ModifyDoors](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyDoors), and work out the height from the story level ([GetStories](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetStories)). | `API_VerticalLinkID` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30) has only the wall bottom, the wall top and a story as the anchor of a window or door (`API_LinkSillTo…`, `API_LinkHeaderTo…`); there is no value for the project zero or a reference level. | [#2575](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2575) |
| A camera with a name of its own, or an axonometric camera | Partly possible | Name the Camera Set the camera is in. For an axonometric view, set the 3D window with [Set3DProjectionSettings](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#Set3DProjectionSettings). | `API_CameraType` holds only `head`, `camSetGuid` and `perspCam` (`API_PerspCamPars`); only `API_CamSetType` has a `name` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). | [#2192](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2192) |
| Remove one direction of a trim between two roofs or shells that trim each other | Workaround | Remove the trim with [RemoveElementTrims](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#RemoveElementTrims), which removes both directions, then trim the other direction again with [TrimElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#TrimElements). | The only removal function, `ACAPI_Element_Trim_Remove (guid_Element1, guid_Element2)` (`ACAPinc.h`, AC25–AC30), “removes trimming connection between the elements” and takes no direction or trim type. | [#2365](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2365) |
| Read or set the joint type (Vertical Cut and the others) and the dx offset of a stair structure | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_StairStructureType` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30) holds `structType`, `bottomType`, thicknesses, `role`, `side`, `isLanding`, `sequenceNumber`, `subElemId` and `API_SideStairStructData` or `API_MonolithStairStructData`; no field, enum or function for the joint type or dx. `GetGDLParametersOfElements` on stair structure sub-elements fails in Archicad 29 build 3200 (“Failed to get parameters of element”). | [#2536](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2536) |
| Change the baseline of an existing stair (move a flight end, a landing or a winder) and keep its GUID | Workaround | Recreate the stair on the new baseline with [RecreateStairs](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#RecreateStairs), which keeps its settings, Element ID, classifications, categories, properties and solid element operations, and returns the old and the new GUID. Its labels are lost. | The table of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`) does not list `API_StairID` among the types whose geometry or memo can change; there is no memo mask for `stairBaseLine` (only `APIMemoMask_StairRiser`, `StairTread` and `StairStructure`), and `ACAPI_Element_ChangeMemo` takes only `APIMemoMask_Polygon` (AC25–AC30). | [#2532](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2532) |
| Set the left and right boundaries or the walking line of a stair (a custom outline, or a walking line off the middle of the flight) | Not possible | Archicad lays them out from the baseline and the flight width: change the baseline with [RecreateStairs](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#RecreateStairs) or the flight width with [ModifyStairs](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyStairs). The walking line stays in the middle of the flight. [GetDetailsOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDetailsOfElements) reads them. | `API_ElementMemo` holds `stairBoundary[2]`, `stairWalkingLine`, `stairCustomWalkLine` and `stairCenterWalkLine` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC29–AC30) with no memo mask of their own, and the table of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`) does not list `API_StairID`. Tried on Archicad 29 build 5101: `ACAPI_Element_Change` answers `APIERR_GENERAL` to the stair's memo with `APIMemoMask_All` or `APIMemoMask_Polygon`, also when it is unchanged, and ignores the lines with the subelement masks; `ACAPI_Element_ChangeExt` answers `APIERR_BADID`; `ACAPI_Element_Create` lays them out again from the baseline, whatever the memo holds (`isCustom` stays false). The `walkingLinePosition` and `walkingLineOffset` of `API_StairType` are not kept either, at creation or after: the walking line stays centered. | [#3014](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/3014) |
| Read which slab or stair edge a railing is linked to, or link a railing to one | Not possible | Read the slab's outline with [GetDetailsOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDetailsOfElements) and create a static railing along the edge with [CreateRailings](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateRailings). When the slab changes, delete the railing and create it again. | `API_RailingType`, `API_RailingSegmentType` and `API_RailingNodeType` hold no host element or edge; the node has only `isStatic` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). `ACAPI_Grouping_GetConnectedElements` and `ACAPI_Element_GetRelations` (`ACAPinc.h`) list no railing connection, and the `ACAPI::` modules have no railing API. | [#2445](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2445) |
| Turn off the automatic story visibility of a railing, so the stories it is shown on can be set | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_RailingType` has `isAutoOnStoryVisibility` and `visibility` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC27 and AC29), but Archicad 29 keeps `isAutoOnStoryVisibility` true after `ACAPI_Element_Change` (with and without the railing’s memo) and `ACAPI_Element_ChangeParameters`, and then ignores `visibility`. Archicad 30 is untested. | [#2448](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2448) |
| Set a label’s optimised position, “use text pen as uniform pen” of a symbol label, or a perpendicular text direction | Partly possible | Set the text direction (parallel, horizontal, vertical or a custom angle) with textWay in [CreateLabels](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateLabels) and [ModifyLabels](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyLabels). When the symbol label’s library part has a parameter for the other two, set it with [SetGDLParametersOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetGDLParametersOfElements); otherwise set them in the Label tool settings or a favorite, and create the labels with favoriteName. | `API_LabelType` has no field for an optimised position or a uniform pen (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). Its `textWay` is documented for labels with only `APIDir_Parallel`, `APIDir_Horizontal`, `APIDir_Vertical` and `APIDir_General`, not `APIDir_Perpendicular`. | [#2666](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2666) |
| Set the Floor Plan Display, Show Projection, uncut and overhead lines or the cut line type of a mesh | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_MeshType` has no `displayOption`, `viewDepthLimitation`, uncut or overhead (`aboveView*`) line pen or type, and no `sectContLtype` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30), as `API_ShellBaseType` of roofs and shells has. Its floor plan members are `contPen`, `ltypeInd`, `levelPen`, `sectContPen`, the cut fill pens, `visibilityCont`, `visibilityFill` and the cover fill, which [ModifyMeshes](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyMeshes) writes. | [#2630](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2630) |
| Read or set the floor plan symbol of a railing: its break mark, which symbol components it shows, their 2D attributes and the symbol overrides | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_RailingType` holds only `head`, `linkToSettings`, `defNode`, `defSegment`, `visibility`, `isAutoOnStoryVisibility`, `nVertices`, `referenceLinePen`, `contourPen`, `nNodes`, `nSegments` and `bottomOffset`; neither it nor `API_RailingSegmentType`, `API_RailingNodeType` and their post, rail, panel and baluster types has a break mark, symbol component, symbol override or 2D attribute field (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). The break mark fields (`breakLinePositionType`, `breakLineDistance`, `breakLineAngle`) are only in `API_StairType`, and the `ACAPI::` modules have no railing API. | [#2573](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2573) |
| Create a radial dimension of an arc, a circle, a curved wall or a curved slab edge | Not documented | Place the radial dimension in Archicad and read it with [GetDetailsOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDetailsOfElements), which returns how Archicad stored it. Those readings are what a create command needs. | `API_RadialDimensionType` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30) has `base` (`API_DimBase`), `endC` and `dimVal` but no centre field, and which point `base.loc` is and which `inIndex` an arc needs are only shown in an image (`neig_rdim.gif`). `ACAPI_Element_Create` (`ACAPinc.h`) lists `API_RadialDimensionID` without notes, and the DevKit’s `Element_Test` example only edits a radial dimension placed by hand (`Do_RadialDimension_Edit`). | [#2660](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2660) |
| Set the profile modifier values, or the stretched width and height, of a wall, beam or column that uses a profile | Partly possible | Read them with [GetProfileValuesOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetProfileValuesOfElements). To change them, change the profile with [CreateProfiles](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateProfiles) (a copy for these elements, or the profile itself), or set them in the settings of the element in Archicad. | `API_WallType`, `API_BeamSegmentType`, `API_ColumnSegmentType` and `API_AssemblySegmentData` have no field for an element’s modifier values or a wall’s stretch (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). `API_ElementMemo` holds only the profile geometry (`customOrigProfile`, `stretchedProfile`, `assemblySegmentProfiles`) and `customParams`, “reserved for internal use”; no `ACAPI_*` function reads or sets the values. The only table of modifier values is the analytical model’s `API_AnalyticalCrossSection::profileParameters` (`APIdefs_AnalyticalModel.h`). | [#2587](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2587) |
| Move a window or door into another wall | Not possible | Delete it and create it in the other wall with [CreateWindows](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateWindows) or [CreateDoors](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateDoors); a favorite (`favoriteName`) gives it the same settings. | `API_WindowType` (also `API_DoorType`) has `owner`, “Reference to the container wall” (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30), but the `API_WindowID`/`API_DoorID` row of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`) lists only `objLoc`, `reflected`, `oSide`, `refSide`, `wallCutUsing` and `libInd` as editable fields. Archicad 29 keeps `owner` after `ACAPI_Element_Change` with it set in the mask, and no function moves an opening into another wall. Archicad 30 is untested. | – |
| Move a skylight onto another roof or shell | Not possible | Delete it and create it on the other roof or shell with [CreateSkylights](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateSkylights). | `API_SkylightType::owner` is the “Reference to the container roof or shell” (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30), but `API_SkylightID` has no row in the supported types of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`), and Archicad 29 keeps `owner` after the change. | – |
| Turn an automatic zone into a manual one | Not possible | Delete the zone and create it again as a manual zone, from its polygon, with [CreateZones](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateZones). | `API_ZoneType::manual` is documented “Manually created zone; all edges static, no reference point (refPos)” (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30), but the `API_ZoneID` row of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`) lists only `libInd`, `pos` and the polygon of the zone. On Archicad 29 a change that sets `manual` (with a new polygon) fails, and the zone stays automatic. | – |
| Change the height of a slanted curtain wall | Not possible | Create it again with [CreateCurtainWalls](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateCurtainWalls), with its `angle` and the new `height`. | `API_CurtainWallType::angle` and `height` are documented “(input only)” (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC29 and AC30), and `API_CurtainWallID` has no row in the supported types of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`). On Archicad 29 neither `ACAPI_Element_Change` nor changed segment contours (`cWSegContour`, `APIMemoMask_CWSegContour`) change the height of a slanted curtain wall. | – |
| Move the lines or the arc of an angle dimension | Not possible | Delete it and create it again with [CreateAngleDimensions](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateAngleDimensions). | The `API_AngleDimensionID` row of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`) says the note and base fields can be modified, but Archicad 29 keeps `base[].loc`, `pos` and `radius` of `API_AngleDimensionType` as they were, also with each point marked in the mask, while the pen and the text change. | – |
| Set the position or the offset of a stair's walking line | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_StairType` has `walkingLinePosition` (`API_LinePositionID`: `APILP_Left`, `APILP_Right`, `APILP_Center`, `APILP_Auto`) and `walkingLineOffset` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30), but `API_StairID` has no row in the supported types of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`), and Archicad 29 keeps a default straight stair at Center, 0.6 m after [ModifyStairs](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyStairs) asks for Left 0.35 m or Right, although ModifyStairs reports success. The position of the walking line symbol (`walkLineSymbPos`), on the other hand, is changed. | – |
| Read or set how a grid element is shown in sections, elevations and interior elevations: its vertical extent and its markers at the top and bottom | Not possible | Select the grid elements in Archicad and set it for all of them at once in their settings dialog. | A grid element is an `API_ObjectID` element with the variation `APIVarId_GridElement` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). `API_ObjectType` has no field for a section, elevation or interior elevation extent or marker, and no header or `ACAPI::` module declares a grid element type or function. The grid marker’s GDL parameters (`AC_MarkerStart`, `AC_MarkerEnd`, `AC_Length`, `AC_LineVisibility`) are its floor plan settings; setting `ac_bottomlevel` or `ac_toplevel` changes nothing in an elevation (reported in Archicad 30). | [#2875](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2875) |

| Project and files | | | | |

Between projects, save the elements as a module with [SaveAsModuleFile](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SaveAsModuleFile), place it in the other project with [CreateHotlinkNodes](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateHotlinkNodes) and [CreateHotlinkInstances](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateHotlinkInstances), and, to keep plain elements, [BreakHotlinkNodes](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#BreakHotlinkNodes). | No clipboard, copy or paste function in `ACAPinc.h`, the `ACAPI_*.h` headers or the `ACAPI::` modules (AC25–AC30). | – |
| Merge a file into the project, as File > Interoperability > Merge does | Workaround | Place the file as a hotlink with [CreateHotlinkNodes](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateHotlinkNodes) and [CreateHotlinkInstances](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateHotlinkInstances), then [BreakHotlinkNodes](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#BreakHotlinkNodes). | The project functions (`ACAPI_ProjectOperation_*`; `APIDo_*ID` in AC25–AC26) open, create, save, close, print and publish, but none merges. `ACAPI_Element_Merge_Elements` is the Merge of construction elements, not of files. | – |
| Delete one offset modifier of a profile | Workaround | Rebuild the profile with [CreateProfiles](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateProfiles)' `replaceSkins` and `newSkins`, which drops every modifier, then add the ones to keep again with `newProfileModifiers` (Archicad 27 and later). | `ProfileVectorImage` (`ProfileVectorImage.hpp`), `ProfileVectorImageOperations` and `VI::ProfileVectorImageBuilder` only add parameters, anchors and dimension control tools (`AddProfileParameter`, `AddOffsetParameter`, `AddOffsetParameterSetup`, `AddAnchor`, `AddDimControlTool`); none removes one, and `DisableControlViaParameter` only disables its control (AC25–AC30). | [#2586](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2586) |
| Import an IFC translator from a file into the project, or export one to a file | Not possible | Keep the office translator in the project template, so new projects have it, and bring it into older projects once with Import… in the IFC Translators dialog. A script can check that a project has it with [GetIFCExportTranslators](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetIFCExportTranslators) and export with it by name with [IFCFileOperation](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#IFCFileOperation). | The IFC translator functions only list the export translators (`ACAPI_IFC_GetIFCExportTranslatorsList`, AC26–AC30; `APIAny_GetIFCExportTranslatorsListID` in AC25), read their relationship data (`ACAPI_IFC_GetIFCRelationshipData`) and open the export settings dialog (`ACAPI_IFC_InvokeIFCExportSettingsDlg`, AC28–AC30). `API_IFCTranslatorIdentifier` (`APIdefs_Automate.h`) has only an internal reference and a name. No function imports, exports, creates or deletes a translator, in `ACAPinc.h` or the `IFCInOutAPI` module (AC25–AC30). | [#2944](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2944) |
| Read the settings of an IFC translator, such as its type mapping and property mapping, for example to check them as the IFC conformity check of the Missing BIM Data report does | Partly possible | Check what the translator gives the elements instead: their IFC type with [GetIFCTypeOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetIFCTypeOfElements), and from Archicad 28 the properties and classification references the preview translator maps to them with [GetIFCPropertiesOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetIFCPropertiesOfElements) and [GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements). [GetAllProperties](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAllProperties) shows whether the properties a mapping needs exist in the project. | `API_IFCTranslatorIdentifier` (`APIdefs_Automate.h`) has only an internal reference and a name. The IFC translator functions only list the export translators (`ACAPI_IFC_GetIFCExportTranslatorsList`, AC26–AC30; `APIAny_GetIFCExportTranslatorsListID` in AC25) and open the export settings dialog (`ACAPI_IFC_InvokeIFCExportSettingsDlg`, AC28–AC30). The `IFCInOutAPI` module (AC28–AC30) reads what the preview translator maps to one element (`IFCAPI::PropertyAccessor::GetPreviewProperties`, `GetPreviewClassificationReferences`), not the mappings. No function reads a translator’s type mapping, property mapping or other settings, or runs a check of them (AC25–AC30). | [#2110](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2110) |
| Find the graphic override rules, Interactive Schedules and SAF translators that refer to a property or classification that no longer exists, as the Missing BIM Data report does | Partly possible | For graphic override rules (from Archicad 27): read the criterion of each rule with [GetGraphicOverrideRules](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetGraphicOverrideRules) (includeCriterion) and compare the properties and classifications it tests with [GetAllProperties](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAllProperties) and [GetAllClassificationSystems](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetAllClassificationSystems). For Interactive Schedules and SAF translators: nothing yet. | A rule’s criterion is `API_OverrideRule::criterionXML` (`APIdefs_Environment.h`), read with `ACAPI_GraphicalOverride_GetOverrideRuleList` and `_GetOverrideRuleById` (AC27–AC30; `ACAPI_Override_GetOverrideRuleList` and `_GetOverrideRule` in AC25–AC26). A schedule is only a Project Map item (`API_ScheduleNavItem`, `APIdefs_Navigator.h`); no function reads its fields or criteria. A SAF translator appears only as a name to export with (`API_SavePars_Saf::selectedSAFTranslatorName`, `APIdefs_Automate.h`, AC26–AC30); no function lists or reads SAF translators. The report itself goes to the Session Report window, which no function reads (see that row) (AC25–AC30). | [#2109](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2109) |
| Export and import, all at once, the settings that the dialogs of Archicad save as XML (properties, classifications, the Layout Book, graphic overrides, Model View Options, IFC and DWG translators), to keep several projects in sync | Partly possible | Copy what the API can write, one kind at a time, in one script run against each project: properties and classifications from their XML files with [ImportPropertiesXml](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ImportPropertiesXml) and [ImportClassificationsXml](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ImportClassificationsXml); attributes from another project with [ImportAttributesFromProject](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ImportAttributesFromProject); graphic override rules with [GetGraphicOverrideRules](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetGraphicOverrideRules) and [CreateGraphicOverrideRules](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateGraphicOverrideRules); Project Info with [GetProjectInfoFields](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetProjectInfoFields) and [SetProjectInfoField](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetProjectInfoField); Favorites with [ExportFavorites](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ExportFavorites) and [ImportFavorites](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ImportFavorites). The Layout Book, Model View Options and the translators: nothing yet. | The only XML imports are `ACAPI_Property_Import` and `ACAPI_Classification_Import` (`ACAPinc.h`); nothing exports properties or classifications to XML. `ACAPI_Favorite_Export` and `_Import` write and read Favorites files. No function imports or exports the Layout Book, graphic override rules or combinations, Model View Options, or the IFC or DWG translators (`ACAPinc.h`, the `ACAPI_*.h` headers and the `IFCInOutAPI` module, AC25–AC30). | [#2113](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2113) |
| Documents and publishing | | | | |
| Read the rows of an Interactive Schedule | Not possible | Build the list yourself: find the elements with [GetElementsByType](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetElementsByType) and read their values with [GetPropertyValuesOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetPropertyValuesOfElements) or [GetQuantitiesOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetQuantitiesOfElements). The [built-in scripts](https://archicad-api.com/scripts/) Room Finishes Schedule and Material Take-Off build such lists. | A schedule appears only as a Project Map item (`API_ScheduleNavItem`, `APIdefs_Navigator.h`), a view node (`API_ViewNodeSchedule`) and a window type (`APIWind_IESCommonDrawingID`, `APIdefs_Database.h`). No function returns its rows (AC25–AC30). | – |
| Export an Interactive Schedule | Workaround | Put the schedule in a publisher set in Archicad once, then publish that set with [PublishPublisherSet](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#PublishPublisherSet). | No schedule export function (AC25–AC30); `ACAPI_ProjectOperation_Publish` (`APIDo_PublishID` in AC25–AC26) publishes a whole publisher set. | – |
| Choose the output format (PDF, DWG, DXF …) of a publisher set per call | Workaround | Make one publisher set per format in Archicad’s Organizer once, then publish the one you need with [PublishPublisherSet](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#PublishPublisherSet); its answer lists the files written (`writtenFiles`). | `API_PublishPars` (`APIdefs_Automate.h`, AC25–AC30) has only the set’s `guid` and an output `path`. The format of an item is `API_NavigatorItem::mimeType` (`APIdefs_Navigator.h`, AC29–AC30 only), which nothing writes: `ACAPI_Navigator_ChangeNavigatorItem` changes the name or ID of View Map items only. | [#2801](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2801) |
| Create a revision Change without placing a Change Marker, or change the ID or description of an existing Change | Partly possible | Create the Change together with its first marker with [CreateChangeMarkers](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateChangeMarkers) (createChange). To change an existing Change, use Archicad’s Change Manager. | The `ACAPI_Revision_*` functions (`ACAPI_Database.h`, AC27–AC30; `APIDb_*RVM*ID` in AC25–AC26) read Changes; the only one that writes, `ACAPI_Revision_ChangeRVMIssue`, changes an Issue. A Change is only created by `ACAPI_Element_Create`/`ACAPI_Element_CreateExt` of a Change Marker with `linkType` `APICMLT_CreateNewChange` (`API_ChangeMarkerType`, `APIdefs_Elements.h`). | [#2658](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2658) |
| Set the custom scheme fields of a revision Change | Not possible | Fill them in Archicad’s Change Manager; [GetRevisionChanges](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetRevisionChanges) reads them back. | `API_RVMChange::customData` (`APIdefs_Database.h`) is only filled by the reading functions; no `ACAPI_Revision_*` functions (`ACAPI_Database.h`, AC27–AC30; `APIDb_*RVM*ID` in AC25–AC26) writes a Change, and `API_ChangeMarkerType` has only `changeId` and `changeName` (AC25–AC30). | [#2658](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2658) |
| Add elements to a revision Change, or remove them from it | Not possible | Add them in Archicad’s Change Manager; [GetRevisionChangesOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetRevisionChangesOfElements) reads which Changes an element belongs to. | `ACAPI_Revision_GetRVMElemChangeIds` (`APIDb_GetRVMElemChangeIdsID` in AC25–AC26) only reads the Changes of an element; no function writes them (AC25–AC30). | [#2658](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2658) |
| Library parts and GDL | | | | |
| Run a 2D GDL script given as text, as [InterpretGDLScript3D](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#InterpretGDLScript3D) does with a 3D script | Workaround | Save the script in a library part with [CreateLibraryParts](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateLibraryParts) (or [SetLibraryPartScripts](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetLibraryPartScripts)), then draw its 2D symbol with [GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives). | The only GDL interpreter function is `ACAPI_LibraryManagement_InterpretGDLScript3D` (`ACAPI_Goodies.h`, AC27–AC30; `APIAny_InterpretGDLScript3DID` in AC25–AC26), for a 3D script; there is no 2D counterpart (AC25–AC30). `ACAPI_LibraryPart_ShapePrims` (`ACAPinc.h`, AC27–AC30; `ACAPI_LibPart_ShapePrims` in AC25–AC26) draws the 2D symbol of a loaded library part that can be placed on the floor plan, with its default parameters or those of a placed instance. | – |
| Get the error message and the line number when a GDL script fails | Not possible | Check whether the script runs with [InterpretGDLScript3D](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#InterpretGDLScript3D) (3D) or [GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives) (2D). To see the error, open the library part in Archicad’s GDL editor with [OpenLibraryPartInEditor](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#OpenLibraryPartInEditor) (from Archicad 27). | `ACAPI_LibraryManagement_InterpretGDLScript3D` returns only `APIERR_GENERAL`, “Failed to interpret the script” (`ACAPI_Goodies.h`), and `ACAPI_LibraryPart_ShapePrims` only error codes (`ACAPinc.h`). `ACAPI::Library::GSMObject` (AC28–AC30) reads and writes the scripts but has no function that checks or compiles them, and no function returns a GDL error message or line number (AC25–AC30). | – |
| Archicad's interface | | | | |
| Read the text of the Session Report window | Not possible | Open the window for the user with [ChangeWindow](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ChangeWindow) and windowType 'Report' (from Archicad 26). | `ACAPI_WriteReport` (`ACAPinc.h`) writes to it and `ACAPI_Dialog_ActivateSessionReport` (`ACAPI_Goodies.h`, AC27–AC30; `APIAny_ActivateSessionReportID` in AC26) opens it; no function reads it (AC25–AC30). | [#1707](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/1707) |
| Get the outcome of an Action Center check | Partly possible | Run the check with [RunActionCenterChecks](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#RunActionCenterChecks); Archicad shows the Action Center when it found an issue. For the hotlink check, read the state of each source with [GetHotlinkSourceStatus](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetHotlinkSourceStatus) (from Archicad 27). | `ACAPI_Window_Check` (`ACAPinc.h`, AC27–AC30; `ACAPI_ActionCenter_Check` in AC25–AC26) returns only an error code; `API_ActionCenterItemID` (`APIdefs_ActionCenter.hpp`) has only `APIActionCenterItem_Hotlinks`. | – |
| Load a new add-on (.apx or .bundle) while Archicad runs, from an add-on or a script | Not possible | Add it in Archicad's Add-On Manager (Options > Add-On Manager > Edit List of Available Add-Ons > Add). An add-on that is already loaded is replaced only after Archicad quits, as the Tapir Installer does when it updates Tapir. | Archicad loads an add-on itself and calls its `CheckEnvironment`, `RegisterInterface`, `Initialize` and `FreeData`; `API_AddonType` (`APIAddon_Normal`, `APIAddon_Preload`, `APIAddon_DontRegister`; `APIdefs_Registration.h`) and `ACAPI_KeepInMemory` (`ACAPinc.h`) only steer the add-on's own loading. No function loads, registers or reloads another add-on (AC25–AC30). | [#2732](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2732) |

Found something else the Archicad API cannot do? Say so in an issue, with the DevKit headers you checked, and it is added here. [Open an issue](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/new/choose)
